description: Repairs r-cat-1/create-mdb-catalog: the TableDefs collection held from the creation view was reused after the CREATE TABLE statements, so TableDefs.Item("H") raised 3265 and H was never marked dbHiddenObject. Fixture r-fix-cat-txn-catalog-mdb (MDB, dbVersion 64): tables T, P2 (two-column primary key) and U, the two-column relationship FK_U_P2 by ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT, table H, a few rows and saved query QSel. Then TableDefs is refreshed, H's Attributes is put to dbHiddenObject (1) and read back (DBEngine.Errors after the put). The Database is closed and reopened read-only and the refreshed TableDefs are listed with Name and Attributes.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
